reviews.text: My first encounter with the team from Chimney Fixers was with Felix Rodriguez. Felix did an outstanding job of identifying the Issues, providing a solution and all the support documentation for the insurance company.
reviews.author: William N.

reviews.text: Had Matt over for a quote and he was very upfront about what needed to be done and provided a quote very quickly, he kept in contact between the quote and installation.
reviews.author: Benedict W.

reviews.text: We had a chimney cap and liner installed, and Jay and Santiago were great! They came on time, did great work, and made sure everything was nice and clean when they left.
reviews.author: Claire P.
